title: KSQAAC Spardha Yashassu NMMS Study Material 2022
heading: Answer check of the NMMS study material
intro: We checked every answer in the book against an independent working, including the Mental Ability Test chapters and the SAT science, social science and maths questions. This report lists every place where the key is wrong, the question has no single right answer, or the text has a misprint, so they can be corrected in the next edition.
method: Each question was typed in from the printed page and given a rule written separately from the book’s solution. A program applies the rule to every option and checks that exactly one option fits and that it matches the key. Picture questions were solved by eye and checked against the key one by one.
Each question has its own rule, written independently of the book, and a program checks that exactly one option is true and that it matches the key.
Each answer was checked against the Karnataka Class 7 and 8 social science textbooks. Where the textbook itself is out of date or wrong, the finding says so.
Every question was worked out again from the printed page, including the figures.
The checks were made on the English text. Where the Kannada differs from the English in a way that changes the answer, the finding says so. The Kannada was not proofread on its own.
footer: Prepared by the team behind NMMS Prep, a free offline practice app built from this study material (valevoor.github.io/nmms-prep). We are grateful to the authors for the material, and happy to share the working behind any finding.
